title: [4K] Relaxing Walk Around Busan Station on a Saturday Afternoon
description:
Filmed on 17/12/2022
Entry time: 3:25pm

I visited Busan Station on a Saturday afternoon a week before Christmas, and it was surprisingly quiet compared to Sunday night: https://youtu.be/LhJ7NB1YIWI). Discover Busan Station's charming side as you follow me on this relaxing Saturday afternoon walk.
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

TIMESTAMPS ⏱️
0:00 Highlights
1:31 Outside of Busan Station
3:37 Inside the Station
8:15 View of Busan Harbour Bridge
10:03 Back Inside
13:35 Exploring More of Busan Harbour Bridge
21:37 Back Inside Again
23:58 Train Departure 
25:04 Exit 
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
